# Demand Letter Skill for Muse

Drafts firm, professional demand letters that stay calm, factual, and specific: header with sender/recipient/date, a neutral chronological statement of facts, the contract clause or obligation relied on, a precise demand with an explicit deadline, and consequences stated factually — never lurid threats. Handles payment demands, breach of contract, cease-and-desist, refunds, and return of property, ending with a pre-send verification checklist (exact figures, governing clause, notice periods, whether counsel should send it). Guardrails run throughout: no insults or defamation, no vague demands, no threats the sender can't lawfully pursue. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: this is a drafting tool, not legal advice — laws and remedies vary by jurisdiction; have a qualified lawyer review before sending, especially before threatening litigation. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
